BankAccount.title: BankAccount
BankAccount.description: A linked local bank account synced via Open Banking API, statement import, or manual connection.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this bank account.

institutionName.description: Name of the financial institution (e.g., Chase, Revolut, Monzo, Wells Fargo).

accountName.description: Display nickname of the account (e.g., Premier Checking, High-Yield Vault).

accountMask.description: Last 4 digits of the account number.

routingCode.description: Local routing number, sort code, or IBAN prefix.

currency.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

accentHex.description: Brand hex color for the bank card.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

TransactionRecord.title: TransactionRecord
TransactionRecord.description: A financial transaction (expense, income, or transfer) linked to a user's bank account.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this transaction.

accountId.description: Document ID of the associated BankAccount.

accountName.description: Denormalized account display name for fast ledger rendering.

isExpense.description: True if this transaction reduces net spending power (expense), false if income.

note.description: Optional user memo or bank reference description.

transactionDateIso.description: ISO-8601 date string (YYYY-MM-DD) when the transaction occurred.

isRecurring.description: True if detected or marked as a recurring bill or subscription.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

BudgetEnvelope.title: BudgetEnvelope
BudgetEnvelope.description: A monthly category budget target and alert threshold.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this budget.

category.description: Spending category governed by this budget envelope.

alertThresholdPercent.description: Percentage (10 to 100) at which to trigger a budget warning.

rolloverEnabled.description: Whether unspent budget rolls over to the next month.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/bank_accounts/{accountId.description: Linked local bank accounts belonging to a specific user.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Transactions imported from bank accounts or logged manually by the user.

/users/{userId}/budgets/{budgetId}.description: Monthly category spending budgets configured by the user.
